items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: I worked with him he’s one of the most magnificent men.

ctx.x: Who is that young man, Spike Lee? Son of a bass player in Chicago? Mo Betta Blues. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
Spike Lee. Really. I worked with him he’s one of the most magnificent men. A true flower child.
Isn’t he, really. He was part of the choir.
